How JobSearch Aide supports your job search

Long image

A

Answer

JobSearch Aide turns the page already open in Chrome into one of four useful actions: save a job, log a contact, fill an application, or update your settings.

  1. Save JD downloads a clean Markdown copy and can add the job to your Application Tracker.1
  2. Outreach can add or update a contact in a separate Outreach Tracker.2
  3. Autofill uses your locally saved profile and does not write to a spreadsheet.3
  4. Your spreadsheet IDs, tab choices, and profile stay in Chrome's local extension storage.4

Applies toCommitted core behavior at b812bf8; current feedback and telemetry edits are not included

  1. Save JD ↗

    Use this on a job listing. Review the company, role, status, and fit before saving.

  2. Log outreach ↗

    Use this on a LinkedIn profile or enter the contact manually.

  3. Autofill form ↗

    Use your saved profile to fill supported fields, then review before submitting.

  4. Update settings ↗

    Add your profile plus the Sheet URL and tab for each tracker.

  • auth → overwrite · connected
  • download → log · next

  • found → append · no
  • found → update · yes

  • lookup → found · URL check
  • overwrite → append · no
  • overwrite → lookup · yes
  • review → download · save

The Markdown file is saved first. If spreadsheet logging fails later, the downloaded job description is still kept.1

  1. Read job page ↗

    The extension extracts the URL, company, role, and job description from the active page.

  2. Download Markdown ↗

    A dated file is saved in Downloads or the chosen subfolder.

  3. Log to Sheets? ↗

    Turn this off when you only want the Markdown file.

  4. Overwrite enabled? ↗

    Turn this on to search by URL and replace an existing row. Leave it off to append.

3

What can happen when a spreadsheet row already exists?

PathHow it detects an existing rowExisting row behavior
Application TrackerExact job URL in column CUpdate only when Overwrite is on; otherwise append a new row.5
Outreach TrackerLinkedIn URL, or name plus company when no URL is presentUpdate allowed status changes, or block a conflicting duplicate.2

If Google sign-in expires

The Application Tracker clears the cached token, asks for a fresh token, and retries the write once. The Outreach path also retries after an authentication error.52
